label: Small Biotech IND — Protocol Synopsis
description: Phase 2 protocol synopsis for NovaTide-1 in R/R DLBCL (randomized, open-label).

inputs.protocol_title: A Phase 2, Randomized, Open-Label Study Evaluating NovaTide-1 vs. Investigator's Choice in Patients with Relapsed/Refractory DLBCL After ≥2 Prior Therapies
inputs.primary_objective: To compare overall response rate (ORR) of NovaTide-1 vs. investigator's choice
inputs.secondary_objective_1: To evaluate duration of response and progression-free survival
inputs.secondary_objective_2: To confirm the safety profile at RP2D with step-up dosing
inputs.secondary_timepoint_2: Continuous throughout treatment + 90 days post last dose
inputs.exploratory_objective: To explore MRD negativity as a predictor of sustained response
inputs.exploratory_endpoint: MRD negativity rate by NGS (10⁻⁶ sensitivity) in bone marrow
inputs.study_design_description: Multicenter, randomized (2:1), open-label study. Arm A: NovaTide-1 3 mg/kg IV weekly × 8 then q2w (with step-up dosing). Arm B: Investigator's choice (gemcitabine-oxaliplatin, lenalidomide, or polatuzumab-BR). Stratification by number of prior therapies (2 vs. ≥3) and prior CAR-T (yes/no).
inputs.inclusion_criteria: 1. Age ≥18 years. 2. Histologically confirmed DLBCL (WHO 2022). 3. Relapsed or refractory after ≥2 prior systemic therapies. 4. Measurable disease (≥1.5 cm in longest dimension). 5. ECOG PS 0–1. 6. Adequate organ function.
inputs.exclusion_criteria: 1. CNS lymphoma involvement. 2. Active autoimmune disease requiring systemic therapy. 3. Prior allogeneic stem cell transplant within 6 months. 4. Live vaccine within 30 days. 5. Active hepatitis B/C or HIV.
inputs.dosage_regimen: 3 mg/kg IV; Step-up: 0.5 mg/kg (C1D1), 1.5 mg/kg (C1D8), 3 mg/kg (C1D15+); then weekly × 5 more, then q2w until PD/toxicity
inputs.treatment_duration: Until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity, or max 2 years
inputs.comparator: Investigator's choice: gemcitabine-oxaliplatin, lenalidomide, or polatuzumab-BR
inputs.sample_size_justification: 180 patients (2:1) provides 80% power to detect ORR improvement from 25% (control) to 45% (NovaTide-1) at one-sided α=0.025 using Fisher's exact test.
inputs.primary_analysis_method: Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel test stratified by randomization factors. ORR with 95% CI.
inputs.interim_analysis: One planned interim analysis at 50% information fraction for futility (conditional power <20%) using Lan-DeMets O'Brien-Fleming spending function.
inputs.screening_procedures: Informed consent, medical history, physical exam, labs, CT/PET scan, bone marrow biopsy, ECG
inputs.baseline_procedures: Confirm eligibility, randomization, pre-dose labs, vital signs, CRS prophylaxis
inputs.visit_1_procedures: Vitals, labs, AE assessment, NovaTide-1 step-up dose 2 (Arm A) or chemotherapy (Arm B)
inputs.visit_2_procedures: Vitals, labs, AE assessment, NovaTide-1 full dose (Arm A) or per regimen (Arm B)
inputs.eot_procedures: Physical exam, labs, CT/PET scan, bone marrow (if baseline positive), QoL, AE assessment
inputs.followup_day: Q3 months for 2 years, then Q6 months
inputs.followup_procedures: Survival status, new anti-cancer therapy, CT scan (Q3mo × 1yr then Q6mo)
